user.title: Apex Monitor Setup
user.description: Enter your Neptune Apex connection info

data_description.password: Optional for monitoring. Needed to control outputs and feed cycles, and for Trident levels and firmware updates.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the Apex. Check the host or IP address.
error.invalid_auth: The Apex rejected the username or password.

abort.already_configured: This Apex is already set up.

data.enable_per_outlet_power: Energy sensors for outlets that measure power

data_description.password: Needed to control outputs and feed cycles, and for Trident levels and firmware updates.
data_description.line_voltage: Used for Total Power (total current × voltage). 120 in North America, 230 in most other places.
data_description.enable_per_outlet_power: Adds an energy (kWh) sensor for each outlet on an energy bar that reports watts (EB832).
data_description.read_only: Monitor only: no control entities or actions, even with a password.

set_output.name: Set output
set_output.description: Sets an Apex output to Auto (its program runs it), On or Off. Target the output's Mode entity.

set_variable.name: Set program
set_variable.description: Replaces an output's program, for example "Set 75" for a variable-speed pump at 75%. The output becomes an Advanced output. Target the output's Mode entity.

set_dos_rate.name: Set DOS rate
set_dos_rate.description: Runs a DOS or DQD pump continuously at a rate in mL per minute, using a profile the integration takes over and renames after the pump (Dose_ and its device ID). 0 turns the pump off. Target the pump's Mode entity.

profile_id.name: Profile
profile_id.description: Number (1-32) of an Apex profile to overwrite for this pump.
